diff --git a/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py b/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
index b38158f..1b09b6d 100644
--- a/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
+++ b/tests/unit/config/test_qtargs.py
@@ -335,6 +335,61 @@ class TestQtArgs:
 
         assert ('--enable-features=OverlayScrollbar' in args) == added
 
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize('backend, expected', [
+        (usertypes.Backend.QtWebEngine,
+         ['--enable-features=CliOne,CliTwo,ArgFeature,ConfigFeature']),
+        (usertypes.Backend.QtWebKit,
+         ['--enable-features=CliOne,CliTwo', '--enable-features',
+          '--enable-features=ConfigFeature']),
+    ])
+    def test_user_enabled_features(self, config_stub, monkeypatch, parser,
+                                   backend, expected):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.objects, 'backend', backend)
+        config_stub.val.scrolling.bar = 'never'
+        config_stub.val.qt.args = ['enable-features=ConfigFeature']
+        parsed = parser.parse_args([
+            '--qt-flag', 'enable-features=CliOne,CliTwo',
+            '--qt-arg', 'enable-features', 'ArgFeature',
+        ])
+
+        args = qtargs.qt_args(parsed)
+        assert [arg for arg in args if arg.startswith('--enable-features')] == expected
+        if backend == usertypes.Backend.QtWebKit:
+            assert args[1:] == ['--enable-features=CliOne,CliTwo',
+                                '--enable-features', 'ArgFeature',
+                                '--enable-features=ConfigFeature']
+
+    def test_enabled_features_with_overlay(self, config_stub, monkeypatch,
+                                           parser):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.objects, 'backend',
+                            usertypes.Backend.QtWebEngine)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.utils, 'is_mac', False)
+        config_stub.val.scrolling.bar = 'overlay'
+        config_stub.val.qt.args = ['enable-features=ConfigFeature',
+                                   'enable-features=MoreFeatures']
+        parsed = parser.parse_args(['--qt-flag', 'enable-features=CliFeature'])
+
+        args = qtargs.qt_args(parsed)
+        assert [arg for arg in args if arg.startswith('--enable-features=')] == [
+            '--enable-features=CliFeature,ConfigFeature,MoreFeatures,'
+            'OverlayScrollbar']
+
+    def test_empty_enabled_features(self, config_stub, monkeypatch, parser):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(qtargs.objects, 'backend',
+                            usertypes.Backend.QtWebEngine)
+        config_stub.val.scrolling.bar = 'never'
+        parsed = parser.parse_args(['--qt-flag', 'enable-features='])
+
+        assert not any(arg.startswith('--enable-features=')
+                       for arg in qtargs.qt_args(parsed))
+
+    def test_enabled_features_helper(self, config_stub):
+        config_stub.val.scrolling.bar = 'never'
+        assert list(qtargs._qtwebengine_enabled_features([
+            '--enable-features=First,Second',
+            '--enable-features=Third',
+        ])) == ['First', 'Second', 'Third']
+
